title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
Fixed the red `pnpm build` on Part 1.

tsup's declaration build roots only the package entry. With `composite: true`, TypeScript then errors (TS6307) on `src/types/dom.ts` and `src/types/event.ts` because those files are imported but are not roots. Widening `include` does not add them as roots. Declaration emit now sets `composite` and `incremental` to false in `@rewind/shared`, `@rewind/recorder`, and `@rewind/player`. `tsc -b` still uses the composite tsconfigs.

Checks on `7fb8b73`: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` all passed. Tests were not changed. Parts 2–5 are still open.
